summary: Iteration 4 (Pro Mode) end-to-end verified. Backend 23/23 pytest green including 14 NEW Pro-mode tests covering: auth-gate (/auth/me, /trips), per-user trip scoping, free-tier watch limit (402 with 'Free tier' detail), Pro grant unlocks unlimited watches, /_admin/run-watcher noop + price-drop alert generation + GET /api/notifications + POST .../read, Stripe /payments/checkout returns {url, session_id} and persists pending+credited=false, /push/register upserts with active=true. Regression optimiser tests (9/9) still pass after the saved-trips flow became auth-gated (old test replaced with note pointing to authenticated coverage in test_pro_mode.py). Frontend mobile-viewport smoke: /login (google-login-btn + skip-btn), /upgrade (£2.99 hero + start-checkout-btn + 4 benefits), /alerts (unauth empty state + alerts-signin-btn), /saved (unauth empty state + saved-signin-btn), home→/results regression (verdict-banner visible, 3+ trip cards). Save button on trip detail correctly redirects unauthenticated user to /login.

react_native_issues.issue: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` warning still logs repeatedly on every page mount (login/upgrade/alerts/saved). Non-blocking but noisy — carryover from iteration 3.

action_items: Optional cleanup: grep & migrate remaining `pointerEvents=` props to `style={{ pointerEvents }}` to silence RN warning.

expo doctor flags version drift: @react-native-community/slider 5.2.0 vs 5.0.1, expo-device 55.0.15 vs ~8.0.10, expo-notifications 55.0.22 vs ~0.32.17. Run `npx expo install --check` to align before next SDK bump. Not currently breaking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 846 lines — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, trips, payments, push, watcher) before it grows further.

payment_status endpoint credits Pro time AND the webhook credits Pro time; idempotency is guarded by `credited` flag but both paths duplicate the 'extend vs set' logic. Good candidate for a single `_credit_pro(user_id, session_id)` helper.
check_watched_trips silently swallows per-trip exceptions with only a warning log — fine operationally, but no error metric/counter to detect systemic watcher failure.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_tripopt_api.py (removed obsolete unauth TestSavedTrips; behaviour now covered with bearer token in test_pro_mode.py)
seed_data_creation: Each pytest test seeds its own TEST_* prefixed user+session directly via pymongo and cleans up in fixture teardown (users, sessions, saved_trips, notifications, push_tokens, payment_transactions). No residue expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro Mode backend fully green. Use pymongo fixtures in test_pro_mode.py as the template for any further auth-gated tests — BASE_URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Stripe /payments/checkout hits integrations.emergentagent.com successfully with sk_test_emergent; emergentintegrations SDK is wired. Frontend auth /login flow cannot be fully E2E'd in headless preview (OAuth redirect to auth.emergentagent.com) — to exercise authenticated UI, seed a user+session in mongo and `localStorage.setItem('tripopt:token', '<session_token>')` before navigating, or inject via api.setToken if exposed globally.
